objections.claim: Candidate §5(e)(iv)'s claimed exclusive publish interval is not exclusive. The custody manifest deliberately retains controller and publisher principals with `contents:write`, which authorizes GitHub release and release-asset mutation. Disabling GitHub Actions stops workflow execution but does not revoke fine-grained PAT/GitHub App credentials or prove that no external process holds one; “offline custody/not loaded” is not a machine-verifiable platform control. Either principal can therefore mutate the bound draft after the final asset/body check and before `draft:false`, defeating the allowlist, attestation check, and frozen-interval oracle. The ceremony must revoke or suspend every non-Eye Contents-write credential during the interval (or otherwise make it platform-verifiably release-incapable), prove release mutation with each credential is denied before the final check, and restore or rotate credentials only after post-publication verification. Until then release blocker 6's fail-closed signed-release contract remains unresolved at release anchor `fc0fa05`.
